notes: A. James Clark School of Engineering official Fall 2026 Chemical Engineering graduation plan. General-education slots (ENGL101, Oral Communication, Professional Writing, Scholarship in Practice, Humanities, History/Social Sciences) are left out: only the program's own requirements are audited here (they're covered by gen-ed-2026-27.ts).
The 'ENMA300 or CHBE457' Big Question slot (Year 3 Spring) is filled with ENMA300, as printed first on the graduation plan's overview page; CHBE457 would satisfy the requirement equally.

The biochemistry sequence (Year 3 Spring) is filled with BCHM463 alone rather than BCHM461+BCHM462, since the plan's own footnote treats the BCHM461 path as the non-default option (it additionally consumes one of the three technical-elective slots with BCHM462).

The three generic 'Tech Elective (see advisor)' slots (Year 4 Fall and Spring) are filled with CHBE451 (Photovoltaics), CHBE472 (Control of Air Pollution Sources) and CHBE482 (Biochemical Engineering), all from the Technical Electives page's list of CHBE senior electives; any three qualifying courses totaling 9 credits would satisfy the requirement.
